_comment: Absence in the phrasing the prompt spells out (#142). The axis is that a child the teacher names absent is still a child the teacher spoke about: Théo gets his note, holding the teacher's words and nothing else. Whether the passage comes back as "absent" or "child" is invisible here — notes are what this scorer grades — and is pinned in backend/llm_live_test.go against the real passageSchema instead. No group remark, deliberately: the roster-wide fan-out (#148 phase 2) must not move these numbers. Each child carries the others' words as must-nots, so copying the transcript into every note fails.
